sentences.text: Nuufolau Joel `` Joe '' Seanoa -LRB- born March 17 , 1979 -RRB- , better known by his ring name Samoa Joe , is an American professional wrestler currently signed to WWE and performing on the Raw brand .	ring name	ring name	professional wrestler	Professional wrestling	WWE	WWE	Raw	WWE Raw

He was previously best known for his time with Total Nonstop Action Wrestling -LRB- TNA -RRB- and Ring of Honor -LRB- ROH -RRB- .	Total Nonstop Action Wrestling	Total Nonstop Action Wrestling	Ring of Honor	Ring of Honor

Joe established himself in ROH from the promotion 's beginning in 2002 , holding the ROH World Championship for a record 21 months from May 2003 to December 2004 .	ROH World Championship	ROH World Championship

Upon joining TNA in June 2005 , he embarked on an 19-month-long undefeated streak , and went on to hold the TNA World Heavyweight Championship once , the TNA X Division Championship five times , the TNA World Tag Team Championship twice , and the TNA Television Championship once ; completing the TNA Triple Crown and the TNA Grand Slam . He also wrestled internationally and on the independent circuit for various promotions , winning several titles , including the GHC Tag Team Championship with Magnus in Pro Wrestling Noah , and he was an inaugural NWA Intercontinental Tag Team Champion with Keiji Sakoda in Pro Wrestling Zero1 .	independent circuit	independent circuit	GHC Tag Team Championship	GHC Tag Team Championship	Magnus	Magnus (wrestler)	Pro Wrestling Noah	Pro Wrestling Noah	NWA Intercontinental Tag Team Champion	NWA Intercontinental Tag Team Championship	Keiji Sakoda	Ryan Sakoda	Pro Wrestling Zero1	Pro Wrestling Zero1
He left TNA in February 2015 , briefly competing again in ROH and the independent circuit .	independent circuit	independent circuit

Joe officially debuted in WWE 's developmental territory NXT in May 2015 , and signed a full-time contract with the company in June ; he went on to become the first ever two-time NXT Champion .	WWE	WWE	NXT	WWE NXT	NXT Champion	NXT Championship
